name: safis-workspace
description: Safis: a Claude skill and toolkit for interactive explainer pages. The npm packages live in packages/, example apps in examples/.

scripts.build: npm run build:template && npm run build:packages
scripts.build:examples: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w examples/react-vite -w examples/vue-vite -w examples/svelte-vite -w examples/astro-blog
scripts.test: node tools/test-engine.mjs && node tools/test-tex.mjs && node tools/test-plot.mjs && node tools/test-sim.mjs && node tools/test-geo.mjs && node tools/test-optics.mjs && node tools/test-sound.mjs && node tools/test-image.mjs && node tools/test-effects.mjs && node tools/test-iso.mjs && node tools/test-engine3d-pro.mjs && node tools/test-parts3d.mjs && node tools/test-bio3d.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run site:build && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.deploy:examples: npm run build:packages && npm run deploy -w examples/react-vite -w examples/vue-vite -w examples/svelte-vite -w examples/astro-blog
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build:packages && npm publish -w packages/safis -w packages/react -w packages/vue -w packages/svelte -w packages/astro --access public
